paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在引言中提及RFID的局限性，但并非直接评价目标论文；目标论文仅作为RFID相关工作的普通引用出现，未明确确认其亚毫米级振动感知能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Wireless systems based on long-wavelength signals represented by RFID [5], [6] have limited displacement sensitivity.
evidences.evidence_context: Existing wireless signal-based solutions still possess certain limitations despite their advantages. Wireless systems based on long-wavelength signals represented by RFID [5], [6] have limited displacement sensitivity. The spatial resolution of WiFi [7] is not sufficient to achieve precise spatial differentiation and multi-point vibration measurement.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” Proc. ACM IMWUT, vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用[5][6]是一组RFID相关工作的一般性提及，并未单独描述目标论文；且属于负面评价（limited displacement sensitivity），不适合作为正面能力佐证。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该论文将目标论文作为RFID长期工作的代表之一，并指出其位移灵敏度有限。
